title: Bridging the Language Gap: Enhancing Multilingual Prompt-Based Code Generation in LLMs via Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in code generation performance across different languages by translating the MBPP dataset into Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, Russian, and Hindi, and comparing error rates (Total Error Rate, Logical Error Rate, Syntax Error Rate) and success rates (All Tests Passed Rate, Code Completion Rate) against English prompts.
